properties.name: openfga.api-url
properties.description: URL to OpenFGA instance. If configured, beans will be initialized.

properties.name: openfga.authorization-model-id
properties.description: The ID of the authorization model to use.

properties.name: openfga.connect-timeout
properties.description: The connect timeout for requests. Default unit is seconds. Defaults to 10 seconds.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.api-audience
properties.description: The API audience. If configured and if {@code CLIENT_CREDENTIALS} is used, the client will use this audience to obtain an access token.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.api-token
properties.description: The API token used to authenticate the client at OpenFGA. Required, if {@code API_TOKEN} method should be used.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.api-token-issuer
properties.description: The API token issuer, used as an additional check. Required, if {@code CLIENT_CREDENTIALS} method should be used.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.client-id
properties.description: The OAuth2 client ID. Required, if {@code CLIENT_CREDENTIALS} method should be used.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.client-secret
properties.description: The OAuth2 client secret. Required, if {@code CLIENT_CREDENTIALS} method should be used.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.config.scopes
properties.description: Space seperated list of OAuth2 scopes used to obtain an access token.

properties.name: openfga.credentials.method
properties.description: The authentication method to use for the OpenFGA client.

properties.name: openfga.default-headers
properties.description: The default headers to use for requests.

properties.name: openfga.http-version
properties.description: The HTTP version to use for requests. Default is HTTP version 2

properties.name: openfga.initialization.mode
properties.description: Whether to perform OpenFGA initialization at startup. Defaults to {@link InitializationMode#NEVER}.

properties.name: openfga.initialization.model-location
properties.description: Location of the authorization model to write, as a Spring resource path (e.g. {@code classpath:fga/model.json}). The resource must contain a JSON {@code WriteAuthorizationModelRequest}. Required when {@link #mode} is {@code EMBEDDED}.

properties.name: openfga.initialization.tuples-location
properties.description: Optional location of the initial tuples to write, as a Spring resource path (e.g. {@code classpath:fga/tuples.json}). The resource must contain a JSON {@code ClientWriteRequest}.

properties.name: openfga.max-retries
properties.description: The maximum number of retries to attempt. Defaults to no retries. If you set this to a positive value, ensure that you also set the {@link OpenFgaProperties#minimumRetryDelay} property.

properties.name: openfga.minimum-retry-delay
properties.description: The maximum delay between retries. Default unit is seconds. Must be set if {@link OpenFgaProperties#maxRetries} is set.

properties.name: openfga.read-timeout
properties.description: The read timeout for request. Default unit is seconds. Defaults to 10 seconds.

properties.name: openfga.store-id
properties.description: The ID of the store to use.

properties.name: openfga.telemetry-configuration
properties.description: The telemetry configuration for the client. See {@link TelemetryMetric} and {@link TelemetryAttribute} as well as Configure SDK Client Telemetry

properties.name: openfga.user-agent
properties.description: The HTTP user agent header to use for requests, default openfga-sdk java/version
